meta.source: hydrowhiplash-elnino26 repository, theme/tokens.json (the master copy; the Design System artifact mirrors it). Adopted by the owner 2026-10-12: green as the essential colour (ecosystems), a natural earth feel, red and blue as the pop colours for fire and rainfall data.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background: a pale lichen grey-green by day, deep conifer at night. The ground for everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Tables, result ledgers, chart panels and the map panel; one step above page.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Notes, code and chart tracks; one step below page.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around panels. Decorative only (about 1.4:1 on page): never the sole marker of meaning.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Axis lines, the no-effect line, region outlines on the map, control borders (3:1 or better on page and surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings and every number, on page, surface and surface-sunk (12.6:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, units, axis labels and credits on page, surface and surface-sunk (5.4:1 or better).

tokens.name: evergreen
tokens.usage: The identity colour: links, the navbar, section rules, and the mark of a result that is significant after Holm. As text on page, surface and surface-sunk (6.6:1 or better). Chrome and verdicts only; never a data series.

tokens.name: on-evergreen
tokens.usage: Text and marks on an evergreen fill (7.6:1 or better).

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Second green for quiet marks: land on diagrams, done states in the timetable. A mark, not small text, in the light theme (4.0:1 on page).

tokens.name: lichen
tokens.usage: Green tint for land on the map and for the hover row; ink reads on it (9.6:1 or better).

tokens.name: fire
tokens.usage: Burned area and fire seasons: bars, dots, the fire toggle. A mark with a label beside it; text stays ink. Never used for errors or emphasis.

tokens.name: fire-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a fire figure or a fire table cell; ink reads on it.

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: Precipitation and winter moisture (rain, SPEI): bars, dots, the rainfall toggle. Deeper than fire in the light theme and lighter in the dark one, so the pair differs in lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: water-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a precipitation figure or table cell; ink reads on it.

tokens.name: snow
tokens.usage: Snowpack (1 April snow water equivalent): marks and the snowpack toggle. Teal, so it stays apart from water's blue.

tokens.name: enso
tokens.usage: A season after an El Niño winter, highlighted on a full-record chart: a tick, an outline or a year label. A mark only (3.2:1 on page in the light theme).

tokens.name: enso-strong
tokens.usage: A season after a strong El Niño winter; always carries its year label as well, since it differs from enso in lightness only.

tokens.name: enso-soft
tokens.usage: The band behind an El Niño season on a full-record chart.

tokens.name: enso-cold
tokens.usage: A La Niña winter on the map page's strip of winters. Steel blue since 2026-10-12: the purple it had went to the ocean ramp (sea-cold). Otherwise reserved for La Niña seasons, a later extension.

tokens.name: enso-neutral
tokens.usage: A neutral winter on the map page's strip of winters; always drawn with a rule outline.

tokens.name: ghost
tokens.usage: A run reported beside a registered test (ONI, frozen rules, Parks Canada, station snow): hollow diamond and thin interval.

tokens.name: fire-1
tokens.usage: Map and heat-table ramp for burned area, lowest step. Ramps are data colours: identical in both themes, always drawn in order, on a surface panel with rule-strong outlines.

tokens.name: fire-2
tokens.usage: Burned-area ramp, step 2.

tokens.name: fire-3
tokens.usage: Burned-area ramp, step 3.

tokens.name: fire-4
tokens.usage: Burned-area ramp, step 4.

tokens.name: fire-5
tokens.usage: Burned-area ramp, highest step.

tokens.name: rain-1
tokens.usage: Ramp for precipitation totals, lowest step.

tokens.name: rain-2
tokens.usage: Precipitation ramp, step 2.

tokens.name: rain-3
tokens.usage: Precipitation ramp, step 3.

tokens.name: rain-4
tokens.usage: Precipitation ramp, step 4.

tokens.name: rain-5
tokens.usage: Precipitation ramp, highest step.

tokens.name: snow-1
tokens.usage: Ramp for snowpack, lowest step.

tokens.name: snow-2
tokens.usage: Snowpack ramp, step 2.

tokens.name: snow-3
tokens.usage: Snowpack ramp, step 3.

tokens.name: snow-4
tokens.usage: Snowpack ramp, step 4.

tokens.name: snow-5
tokens.usage: Snowpack ramp, highest step.

tokens.name: temp-cold-2
tokens.usage: Temperature, a diverging ramp around the region's normal: well below normal.

tokens.name: temp-cold-1
tokens.usage: Temperature: below normal.

tokens.name: temp-mid
tokens.usage: Temperature: near normal, the ramp's midpoint.

tokens.name: temp-warm-1
tokens.usage: Temperature: above normal.

tokens.name: temp-warm-2
tokens.usage: Temperature: well above normal.

tokens.name: precip-dry-2
tokens.usage: Precipitation as a share of normal, a diverging ramp around 100%: far below normal. Dry earth, not red: red is kept for burned area.

tokens.name: precip-dry-1
tokens.usage: Precipitation as a share of normal: below normal.

tokens.name: precip-mid
tokens.usage: Precipitation as a share of normal: at normal, the ramp's midpoint.

tokens.name: precip-wet-1
tokens.usage: Precipitation as a share of normal: above normal (the value of rain-3).

tokens.name: precip-wet-2
tokens.usage: Precipitation as a share of normal: far above normal (the value of rain-5).

tokens.name: sea-cold-2
tokens.usage: Sea-surface temperature on the map page's ocean panels, a diverging ramp around the winter average, purple to amber so that it cannot be read as a region's value: over 1 °C cooler.

tokens.name: sea-cold-1
tokens.usage: Sea-surface temperature: cooler.

tokens.name: sea-mid
tokens.usage: Sea-surface temperature: near the average, the ramp's midpoint.

tokens.name: sea-warm-1
tokens.usage: Sea-surface temperature: warmer.

tokens.name: sea-warm-2
tokens.usage: Sea-surface temperature: over 1 °C warmer (the light value of enso, the El Niño colour).

styles.name: page-title
styles.sample: What past El Niños suggest for the 2027 fire season

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section headings; a 2px evergreen rule sits above each.

styles.name: subsection
styles.usage: Headings inside a section; limitation claims.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: A headline count. At most one row of these on a page, and only where the figures are the point.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: I fixed 52 tests in writing before opening any fire data, then ran them once.
styles.usage: The answer-first paragraph under a page title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: These are associations over about 42 seasons, not causes.
styles.usage: Prose, at most 68 characters a line.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Bars are 95% intervals; the vertical line is no effect.
styles.usage: Captions, credits and notices; set in ink-muted.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: Column heads, eyebrows and key headings, uppercase, in ink-muted.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Estimates, intervals, p-values, dates, commit hashes; tabular figures and a true minus sign.

styles.name: figure-strong
styles.usage: The one figure a row is about.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Swatch to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row padding in a ledger; gap inside a key.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Cell padding; gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; the minimum side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its figure.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Swatches, interval bars, bar tops.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, controls.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Dataset toggles and state chips only.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Rules, gridlines, contour lines.

tokens.name: stroke-mark
tokens.usage: Section rules, dot outlines, the no-effect line on a key.

tokens.name: stroke-interval
tokens.usage: A registered test's 95% interval bar.
